params.name: offset
params.description: The number of items to skip. Useful for pagination (page number * limit)

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to fetch

params.name: user_id
params.description: The user ID of the user making the request

params.name: receiver_min_followers
params.description: Only include tips to recipients that have this many followers

params.name: receiver_is_verified
params.description: Only include tips to recipients that are verified

params.name: current_user_follows
params.description: Only include tips involving the user's followers in the given capacity. Requires user_id to be set.

params.name: unique_by
params.description:
Only include the most recent tip for a user was involved in the given capacity.

Eg. 'sender' will ensure that each tip returned has a unique sender, using the most recent tip sent by a user if that user has sent multiple tips.

params.name: min_slot
params.description: The minimum Solana slot to pull tips from

params.name: max_slot
params.description: The maximum Solana slot to pull tips from

params.name: tx_signatures
params.description: A list of transaction signatures of tips to fetch

items.docs: Gets the most recent tips on the network
